children: Dear Sirs

children.name: text
children: {b:Letter of Intent dated: The {ProjectName} (the "Project") at {SiteAddress} (the "Property")}

children.name: text
children: We appoint you to perform the Specified Works, subject to the following conditions:

children.name: text
children: {b:Definitions and interpretation}

children.name: text
children: The following definitions and rules of interpretation apply in this letter.

children.name: text
children: Definitions:

children.name: text
children: {b:Access Regime:} an access regime to gain access to the Property, as reasonably agreed between the Sub-Contractor and Culena London Limited.

children.name: text
children: {b:Contract:} JCT Design and Build 2016 edition (with amendments) contract to be entered into in respect of the Works concerning the Property.

children.name: text
children: {b:Maximum Amount:} {MaximumAmountLetterIntent}

children.name: text
children: {b:Project:} as defined in the heading of this letter.

children.name: text
children: {b:Property:} as defined in the heading of this letter.

children.name: text
children: {b:Sub-Contractor:} {TheSupplier} (Registration number: {RegisteredNumber}) Whose registered address is {RegisteredAddress} appointed by The Contractor to undertake the {PackageName} works at the Property.

children.name: text
children: {b:Specified Works:} those works listed in Annex 1

children.name: text
children: {b:Works:} {ProjectDescription} taking place at the Property

children.name: text
children: Paragraph and any annex or appendix headings shall not affect the interpretation of this letter.

children.name: text
children: A {b:person} includes a natural person, corporate or unincorporated body (whether or not having separate legal personality) and that person's personal representatives, successors and permitted assigns.

children.name: text
children: Any annexes or appendices form part of this letter and shall have effect as if set out in full in the body of this letter. Any reference to this letter includes any annexes and appendices.

children.name: text
children: A reference to a {b:company} shall include any company, corporation or other body corporate, wherever and however incorporated or established.

children.name: text
children: Unless the context otherwise requires, words in the singular shall include the plural and in the plural shall include the singular.

children.name: text
children: Unless the context otherwise requires, a reference to one gender shall include a reference to the other genders.

children.name: text
children: A reference to a party shall include that party's personal representatives, successors and permitted assigns.

children.name: text
children: A reference to a statute or statutory provision is a reference to it as amended, extended or re-enacted from time to time.

children.name: text
children: A reference to a statute or statutory provision shall include all subordinate legislation made from time to time under that statute or statutory provision.

children.name: text
children: Any reference to a party's {b:consent} or {b:approval} being required is to a consent or an approval in writing which must be obtained before the relevant act is taken or event occurs.

children.name: text
children: Any obligation on a party not to do something includes an obligation not to allow that thing to be done.

children.name: text
children: A reference to {b:writing} or {b:written} includes fax but not e-mail, unless we have both agreed otherwise.

children.name: text
children: References to paragraphs, annexes and appendices are to the paragraphs, annexes and appendices of this letter.

children.name: text
children: Unless this letter otherwise expressly provides, a reference to the Property or the Project is to the whole and any part of it.

children.name: text
children: {b:Duration and effect of this letter}

children.name: text
children: Our mutual obligations under this letter start on the date of this letter or, if earlier, the date on which you commenced performance of the Specified Works until the termination of your appointment under this letter.

children.name: text
children: Our mutual rights and obligations in respect of the Specified Works shall be given by the terms of this letter

children.name: text
children: If we decide to appoint you to carry out the Works, our mutual rights and obligations in respect of all matters with which this letter is concerned (including any design performed or any work carried out or order placed under this letter as part of the Specified Works or otherwise shall be subsumed into and be subject to the Contract.

children.name: text
children: {b:Payment}

children.name: text
children: You will provide us a proposal of costs before commencing the Specified Works and under this letter.

children.name: text
children: Subject to paragraph 4.1, we will pay you for the Specified Works once the proposal of costs is agreed with us in writing.

children.name: text
children: you shall submit to us an invoice for each instalment of the Fee, together with any supporting documents that are reasonably necessary to check the invoice. The invoice and supporting documents (if any) shall specify the sum that you consider will become due on the payment due date in respect of the instalment of the Fee, and the basis on which that sum is calculated;

children.name: text
children: payment will be due when we require such invoice;

children.name: text
children: no later than 28 days after payment becomes due, we shall notify to you the sum that we consider to have been due at the payment due date in respect of the payment and the basis on which that sum is calculated;

children.name: text
children: the final date for payment shall be 30 days after the date on which payment becomes due;

children.name: text
children: unless we serve a notice under paragraph 3.1.7, we shall pay the sum referred to in our notice under paragraph 3.1.4 (or, if we do not serve a notice under clause 1.4 the sum referred to in the invoice referred to in paragraph 3.1.2) ("the notified sum") on or before the final date for payment of each invoice;

children.name: text
children: not less than 7 days before the final date for payment, we may give you a notice that we intend to pay less than the notified sum. Any notice we serve under this paragraph 3.1 shall specify the sum that we consider to be due on the date the notice is served and the basis on which that sum is calculated;

children.name: text
children: if we fail to pay you the amount due by the final date for payment and fail to give you a payless notice under paragraph 3.1.7 simple interest shall be added to the unpaid amount from the final date for payment until the actual date of payment. This shall be calculated on a daily basis at the rate of 2% above the Base Rate set by the Bank of England from time to time. Both of us acknowledge that out liability under this paragraph 3.1.8 is a substantial remedy for the purposes of Section 9(1) of the Late Payment of Commercial Debts (Interest) Act 1998.

children.name: text
children: Our obligation to pay you is limited to our payment for the Specified Works. This letter does not authorise you to carry out further or other works or services and we are not obliged to:

children.name: text
children: pay you for any further or other works, goods, materials or services; or

children.name: text
children: enter into the Sub-Contract or any other contract with you

children.name: text
children: as a result of entering into this letter.

children.name: text
children: {b:Our limit of liability}

children.name: text
children: Our total liability to you under or in connection with this letter shall be limited to the Maximum Amount, plus any Value Added Tax on that sum.

children.name: text
children: You shall notify us as soon as practicable if you become aware that:

children.name: text
children: your performance of the Specified Works; or

children.name: text
children: any act, omission, request or instruction from us or our agents would mean that, but for paragraph 4.1, you would be entitled to be paid a sum greater than the Maximum Amount. You shall not commit to expenditure above the Maximum Amount without our prior written approval.

children.name: text
children: Without affecting paragraph 4.1, you acknowledge and agree that you shall have no claim against us under or in connection with the Project, the Works any failure to enter into the Sub-Contract or this letter for:

children.name: text
children: loss of profit, loss of contract, loss of business, loss of chance or other similar loss; or

children.name: text
children: any indirect or consequential loss.

children.name: text
children: {b:Sub-contracts}

children.name: text
children: You may only enter into a sub-contract or place a supply contract in connection with the Specified Works subject to our prior written consent.

children.name: text
children: Any sub-contract or supply contract you enter into shall permit you to assign the benefit of that contract to us or our nominee. On termination of this letter (or your appointment under this letter) for any reason, if instructed by us you shall without charge assign the benefit of any or all of those contracts to us or our nominee, as we may specify.

children.name: text
children: {b:Insurance}

children.name: text
children: Within five Business Days of the date of this letter, and on our reasonable request from time-to-time, you shall provide written evidence to us that you maintain the following insurance cover for at least £10,000,000 on an each and every basis:

children.name: text
children: professional indemnity insurance; and

children.name: text
children: public liability insurance

children.name: text
children: as required by this letter.

children.name: text
children: Before you carry out any Specified Works at the Property, you shall ensure that you maintain (and you shall provide written evidence to us that you maintain) any insurance required by paragraph 6.1 of this letter.

children.name: text
children: On our reasonable request from time-to-time, you shall provide written evidence to us that you continue to maintain such insurance.

children.name: text
children: {b:Copyright}

children.name: text
children: You hereby grant us an irrevocable, royalty-free, non-exclusive licence to copy and use any drawings details and specifications of materials, goods and workmanship and other related document preferred by you or on your behalf in relation to the design of the Specified Works ("Materials") and to reproduce the designs and content of them for any purpose relating to the Specified Works, including without limitation in the construction, completion, maintenance, letting sale, promotion advertisement, reinstatement, refurbishment and repair of the Specified Works. Such licence shall enable us to copy and use the Materials for the extension of the Specified Works but shall not include a licence to reproduce the designs contained in them for any extension of the Specified Works

children.name: text
children: {b:Terms in the Contract}

children.name: text
children: You agree that the Contract shall include, {em:inter alia}, the following terms:

children.name: text
children: a.

children.name: text
children: the Contract Sum Analysis (as defined in the Letter of Intent) shall be as per the breakdown provided at {b:Annex 2}.

children.name: text
children: b.

children.name: text
children: The Contract Sum (as defined in the Letter of Intent ) under the Letter of
Intent shall be £{OrderPrice}+VAT

children.name: text
children: c.

children.name: text
children: the Date of Possession and the Date of Completion (as defined in the Letter of Intent) shall be as follows:
Date of Possession: {DatePossessionLOI}
Date of Target Completion: {DateTargetLOI}

children.name: text
children: d.

children.name: text
children: the Works programme shall be delivered on the basis of the programme provided at {b:Annex 3}.

children.name: text
children: e.

children.name: text
children: the Access Regime as reasonably agreed between the Sub-Contractor and The Main Contractor, describing the access to and out of the Property.

children.name: text
children: {b:Termination and consequences of termination}

children.name: text
children: Either one of us can terminate this agreement by serving a 7 day notice on the other.

children.name: text
children: If your appointment under this letter is terminated, either by us or you:

children.name: text
children: subject to paragraph 4, we shall pay you any sums due under paragraph 3, and that payment shall be your sole compensation for termination;

children.name: text
children: we shall both co-operate to bring the Specified Works to an orderly conclusion and to allow us both to comply with our remaining obligations under this letter (including your obligations under paragraph 5.2 and paragraph 7); and

children.name: text
children: you shall stop work under this letter and, if you have entered onto the Property, you shall vacate the Property, leaving it in a clean, tidy and safe condition.

children.name: text
children: {b:Side Letter}
N/A

children.name: text
children: {b:Confidentiality}

children.name: text
children: Both we and you undertake not to disclose to any person any confidential information concerning the business, affairs, customers, clients or suppliers of the other party, except as permitted by paragraph 11.2.

children.name: text
children: We or you may disclose the other party's confidential information:

children.name: text
children: to our respective employees, officers, representatives, or advisers who need to know such information for the purposes of carrying out the party's obligations under this letter. Each party shall ensure that its employees, officers, representatives, or advisers to whom it discloses the other party's confidential information comply with this paragraph 11; and

children.name: text
children: as may be required by law, a court of competent jurisdiction or any governmental or regulatory authority.

children.name: text
children: Neither we nor you shall use each other's confidential information for any purpose other than to perform our respective obligations under this letter.

children.name: text
children: {b:Tiered dispute resolution}

children.name: text
children: if any dispute or difference arises under this Contract, directors or other senior representatives of the parties with authority to settle the dispute shall, within 5 business days of a notice from one Party to the other, meet in a good faith effort to resolve the dispute or difference;

children.name: text
children: if the dispute or difference is not resolved at the meeting referred to in clause 12.1, the parties may refer a dispute arising under this letter to adjudication at any time under Part I of the Scheme for Construction Contracts (England and Wales) Regulations 1998 (as may be amended from time to time), which shall take effect as if it was incorporated into this letter.

children.name: text
children: The adjudicator nominating body for the purpose of this letter shall be the RICS.

children.name: text
children: {b:Third Party Rights}

children.name: text
children: No one other than a party to this letter, their successors and permitted assignees, shall have any right to enforce any of its terms pursuant to the Contract (Rights of Third Parties) Act 1999.

children.name: text
children: {b:Entire agreement}

children.name: text
children: This letter constitutes the entire agreement between you and us and supersedes and extinguishes all previous drafts, agreements, arrangements and understandings between you and us, whether written or oral, relating to its subject matter.

children.name: text
children: Neither we nor you shall have remedies in respect of any statement, representation, assurance or warranty (whether made innocently or negligently) that is not set out in this letter. Neither we nor you shall have a claim for innocent or negligent misrepresentation or negligent misstatement based on any statement in this letter.

children.name: text
children: {b:Notices}

children.name: text
children: Any notice served or required to be served under this letter shall be in writing.

children.name: text
children: {b:Governing law}

children.name: text
children: This letter and any dispute or claim arising out of or in connection with it or its subject matter or formation (including non-contractual disputes or claims)

children.name: text
children: shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the law of England and Wales.

children.name: text
children: {b:Jurisdiction}
{br}

You and we irrevocably agree that the courts of England and Wales shall have exclusive jurisdiction to settle any dispute or claim that arises out of or in connection with this letter or its subject matter or formation (including non-contractual disputes or claims).
{br}
Please acknowledge receipt and acceptance of this letter by signing, dating and returning the enclosed copy.

children.name: text
children: Yours faithfully
